description_en: Queries the custom topic categories of a specified product
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定产品的自定义Topic类
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-product-topic --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key HMyB0000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryProductTopic

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
